training_source: ChEMBL CHEMBL251 exact Ki, human binding assays with confidence 9, literature source and no annotated variant
label: pKi = 9 - log10(Ki in nM)
external_aggregation: unweighted mean of five validation-fold models
architecture: existing full SGF-DTA affinity network; frozen Uni-Mol2 and ESM-2 features; freshly trained affinity head and interaction branch
feature_exclusion: 29 training structures failed both standard ETKDG and random-coordinate embedding using the unchanged encoder algorithm, before affinity fitting. All 1170 external candidates passed conformer generation. Uncached molecules were checked in eight parallel CPU processes to reduce preparation time.
selection_basis: Chosen after the ESR1 exploratory case because of a larger systematically measured candidate panel, a direct binding endpoint, a confirmed human GPCR and public Ki reference coverage. No ADORA2A predictions or model performance examined when choosing the target.
scope: Second exploratory non-kinase screening case; retrospective parent-disjoint evaluation. ESR1 is retained as the first attempted case.
external_endpoint: AC50 from direct ADORA2A binding in the Secondary Pharmacology Database; concentration threshold 10 micromolar
candidate_policy: Exclude missing/invalid structures, unsupported encoder size and all repeated standardized parent groups, without using activity to choose representatives. Assign Active for exact AC50 <= 10000 nM, Inactive for exact AC50 > 10000 nM or a strict lower bound >= 10000 nM; exclude threshold-ambiguous bounds.
target_mapping: Original author Zenodo 7378746 SI_tables_release.xlsx Table S2 row 8 identifies assay 3177 as human ADORA2A binding. ChEMBL5291726 has confidence 8 (homologous) despite its human description; original experimental annotation establishes the species.
